items.markdown:
`British citizens do not need a visa for tourist or short business stays up to 60 days` . Instead, you qualify for a visa exemption, but you must complete a digital arrival form and meet basic passport rules.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)[[2]](https://cibtvisas.co.uk/thailand-visa)[[3]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23)

Entry Requirements

- **Digital Arrival Card:** You must complete the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card online within 3 days before your flight.
- **Passport Validity:** Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months from your arrival date and have 1 blank page.
- **Onward Travel:** You must hold proof of an onward or return ticket.
- **Stay Duration:** You can stay up to 60 days, which can be extended once by 30 days at a local Thai immigration office for a fee.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/do-you-need-a-visa-for-thailand-tourist-visa-rules-explained.html)

When You Do Need a Visa

- **Longer Stays:** If you plan to stay past 90 total days, work, or study.
- **Other Nationalities:** If you hold a passport from a country not included in the 93 visa-exempt nations, you must apply through the [Thai E-Visa Official Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) before departure.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)

If you'd like, let me know:

- Your **exact passport nationality** (if other than British)
- The **length of your planned trip** 

I can verify your exact exemption status or guide you through an e-visa application.
